title: Hazelcast Diagnostics Log Entry
description: Schema for a single newline-terminated JSON object produced by Hazelcast Diagnostics when DiagnosticsLogFormat.JSON is configured. One object is emitted per plugin execution. Output is compact JSON with no whitespace between tokens.
$comment: Loki / Grafana ingestion: (1) use a Promtail/Alloy timestamp stage pointing at 'epoch' with format 'UnixMs'; (2) promote 'name' to a stream label so streams can be selected with {name="Metric"} or {name="SlowOperations"}; (3) parse remaining fields with the 'json' pipeline stage.
$comment_required: epoch is always present: DiagnosticsLogWriterJsonImpl emits it directly; DiagnosticsLogConverter derives it from the 'time' field (second precision, millis=000) when the source STANDARD log was written without epoch. A human-readable 'time' field is intentionally absent — it is redundant with 'epoch' and uses a non-ISO day-first format tied to the JVM default timezone.

epoch.description: Unix epoch time in milliseconds. Always present. DiagnosticsLogWriterJsonImpl emits it directly; DiagnosticsLogConverter derives it from the STANDARD header timestamp (second precision, millis=000) when the source log had no epoch. Use as the Loki timestamp (configure as 'UnixMs' in Promtail/Alloy timestamp stage). All lines from a single MetricsPlugin collection share the same epoch value.

name.description: Identifies the diagnostics plugin or event type that produced this line. Use as a Loki stream label for efficient log stream selection and filtering. Examples: name="Metric", name="SlowOperations", name="OverloadedConnections". StoreLatencyPlugin uses the service name (e.g. MapService, CacheService) — any name not in the known list is a StoreLatency line.

content.description: Plugin-specific payload. Always a JSON object, never null. Structure varies by plugin — see the per-plugin catalogue in diag_in_json.md. For Loki: after the 'json' pipeline stage, nested fields are accessible as content_fieldName.

section.description: A diagnostics section. Keys are plugin-defined strings. Values are primitives, nested sections, or the reserved 'entries' array. The 'entries' key is absent (not null, not []) when no writeEntry/writeStructuredEntry calls were made in that section.

textEntry.title: TextEntry
textEntry.description: A plain-text entry produced by writeEntry(String). The string is JSON-escaped and wrapped under the 'text' key.

text.description: The plain-text value passed to writeEntry().

structuredEntry.title: StructuredEntry
structuredEntry.description: A structured entry produced by writeStructuredEntry(Object... kvPairs). Carries plugin-defined key/value pairs as a JSON object.

entryItem.title: EntryItem
entryItem.description: A single item inside an 'entries' array. Always a JSON object. Either a TextEntry ({"text":"..."}) from writeEntry(), or a StructuredEntry with plugin-defined keys from writeStructuredEntry().

value.title: SectionValue
value.description: Any value that may appear as a property value inside a diagnostics section.

anyOf.description: String value, including datetime strings from writeKeyValueEntryAsDateTime.
Long or int value from writeKeyValueEntry(key, long) or writeKeyValueEntry(key, int).

Floating-point value from writeKeyValueEntry(key, double). Note: NaN is emitted as the bare token NaN which is not strictly valid JSON — validators and parsers should be tolerant if diagnostics data includes NaN metric values.

JSON null produced by: (1) writeKeyValueEntry(key, (String) null) — used by MetricsPlugin.collectNoValue to indicate a metric that was registered but had no value at collection time; (2) writeStructuredEntry when a null value argument is passed.

anyOf.title: EntriesArray
anyOf.description: The reserved 'entries' array produced by writeEntry() and/or writeStructuredEntry(). Items are always JSON objects (never bare primitives): writeEntry() wraps strings as {"text":"..."}; writeStructuredEntry() produces plugin-defined key/value objects. Always present as an array even for a single call; never empty.

anyOf.title: NamedArray
anyOf.description: A named array produced by startArrayItemSection(). Each item is a section object. Used by OverloadedConnectionsPlugin for the 'connection' key to avoid duplicate JSON keys when the same connection appears in both normal and priority queue scans.
Nested section object produced by a startSection/endSection pair inside a parent section.

metricKey.title: MetricKey
metricKey.description: The parsed metric key used as a dynamic property name in Metric content objects. Format: [prefix.]metric[discriminator=value][tag=value]*(unit). Prefix and metric are dot-separated path segments. Discriminator/tag segments use [key=value] bracket notation. Unit (if present) is parenthesised and lower-cased. Absence of a unit segment means the metric has no unit.
